verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. God, hear me as I tell you my complaint. Protect my life from the terror of my enemy.
Hide me from the secret plans of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of evil people.
They sharpen their tongues like swords. They aim their cruel words like deadly arrows.
They shoot from hiding places at innocent people. They shoot suddenly and are not afraid.
They encourage each other in their evil plans. They talk about setting hidden traps. They say, "Who will see them?"
They plan their crimes and say, "We have a perfect plan!" The human mind and heart are very cunning.
But God will shoot them with his arrows. Suddenly they will be struck down.
Their own words will bring them down. Everyone who sees them will shake their heads.
All people will be afraid. They will tell what God has done and think carefully about his works.
Good people will be glad in the LORD and find safety in him. All whose hearts are honest will praise him!
